items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...go back to Scott Joplin ... [INTERVIEWEE] I don't know whether I have or not. I don't really know whether I know what you're talking about.

ctx.x: back at you. But if it's good, it will come back at you, too.

Well, what do you think about this trend of a lot of the so-called Avant-Garde musicians or the New musicians, who in their repertoire, besides playing the outside stuff, will take stuff from years ago, even going back to Scott Joplin and Jelly Roll Morton and Fletcher Henderson, and play it, but it doesn't seem like it's played quite the same way. Not that you'd want them to play it exactly like that... But have you heard any of that?
I don't know whether I have or not. I don't really know whether I know what you're talking about.
